title: Most seriene place+ flying
content: My dream got very lucid last night I was with a group of people my class and teacher I didn't know my schedule and arrived to class late and the teacher wouldn't let me leave but he ended up taking us to a trip to a beautiful place with waterfalls and plants and super bright beautiful light and when we got there I noticed a guy was sitting partly on a cliff and off a cliff there was some sorta invisible forcefield ground that we were able to stand on it was completely clear beneath us and after that I just jumped up and flew away I saw so many different structured smaller city/places like a huge colicium movie theater as I flew higher the landscape kinda seems like canon ish like dry lands open sun very big landscape that's flat with small structures and tiny city spaces I've been to that lots other times I'm near forrests and actual city's so I'm not exactly sure where this area is and idk why the teacher brought us there I've seen a lot of theories about mw being some sorta training thing and I do believe it I'm always being brought on field trips to experience something or forced to be apart of "missions" and I'm usually with a group of people although i can't exactly remember who they are but it feels as real as day I was just flying and now I'm here
